sayLines.line: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
Sarah is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
📓 Journal: Sarah taught the woman in her 50s, with calloused knuckles Herbal Medicine.
🧭 Norman is back from the east. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
The System notes the synergy — healed someone back from the brink: +2 craft XP.

You have Wound Fever. Wound Fever — infection in an open cut. Clean it properly (field medicine, triage), poultice it (herbal), or hit it with antibiotics. All three work. (Antibiotics would end it.) The ruins to the east sometimes still hold medicine cabinets — worth searching. — diagnosed by Milton.
💡 KNOWLEDGE COMBINES: Blackberry — Level 2. You knew it was safe. the village knew the rest. Together, it's deeper. Parts: berries (eat), leaves (tea), roots (medicinal). Pick ripe (black, not red).

Deeper knowledge: Blackberry. Uses: vitamin C, antioxidants. Leaves for diarrhea. High energy. (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: ripe black berries, straight off the cane; medicine: leaf tea settles the stomach; dye: deep purple-black dye from the juice.
